title: Characterization and domain dissection of a PL39 alginate lyase algtm3 from the marine thermophile Rhodothermus profundi.
authors: Yu, Jiaqing; Kong, Ruimin; Guo, Jingyue; Fu, Ruixuan; Bin, Yiqing; Li, Wei; Ren, Yao; Ge, Fanglan
one_liner_zh: 该文表征了来自海洋嗜热菌的PL39褐藻胶裂解酶Algtm3，并通过结构建模和分子对接分析其结构-功能关系，虽以酶为对象且方法较基础，但结构建模与对接思路对蛋白质结构计算研究有一定参考价值。
abstract: Alginate lyases are important biocatalysts for the preparation of bioactive alginate oligosaccharides from brown algae. However, the application of currently available alginate lyases is often constrained by insufficient thermostability and catalytic efficiency. In this study, a PL39 family alginate lyase, designated Algtm3, was identified from the thermophilic deep-sea bacterium Rhodothermus profundi (type strain PRI 2902ᵀ = DSM 22212ᵀ = JCM 15944ᵀ) through genome mining, heterologously expressed in Escherichia coli, and systematically characterized. Algtm3 exhibited optimal activity at 70  degrees C and pH 8.0, and retained more than 90% of its initial activity after incubation at 65  degrees C for 60 min, indicating excellent thermal stability. Domain truncation analysis revealed that the Chondroitin AC/alginate lyase superfamily domain and the Hepar_II_III catalytic domain are essential for maintaining proper protein folding, soluble production, and catalytic activity. In contrast, deletion of the C-terminal T9SS sorting domain improved enzyme performance in the heterologous expression system, with the truncated variant Algtm3dc exhibiting a 1.98-fold higher activity than the wild-type enzyme. Structural modeling and molecular docking analyses suggested that C-terminal truncation preserved the catalytic core while inducing local changes in the substrate-binding region, which may contribute to enhanced catalytic efficiency. TLC and ESI-MS analyses demonstrated that Algtm3 could degrade sodium alginate, polyM, and polyG, producing alginate oligosaccharides mainly with degrees of polymerization ranging from 1 to 4, and exhibited both endolytic and exolytic degradation characteristics. Collectively, these findings provide insights into the domain organization and structure-function relationship of PL39 family alginate lyases and highlight the potential of Algtm3 as a thermostable biocatalyst for the efficient production of functional alginate oligosaccharides.
abstract_zh: 海藻酸裂解酶是制备来自褐藻的生物活性海藻酸寡糖的重要生物催化剂。然而，目前可用的海藻酸裂解酶的应用常受限于热稳定性不足和催化效率低下。本研究通过基因组挖掘，从嗜热深海细菌 *Rhodothermus profundi*（模式菌株 PRI 2902ᵀ = DSM 22212ᵀ = JCM 15944ᵀ）中鉴定出一种PL39家族海藻酸裂解酶，命名为Algtm3，并在 *Escherichia coli* 中异源表达及系统表征。Algtm3在70摄氏度和pH 8.0条件下表现出最佳活性，在65摄氏度孵育60分钟后仍保留超过90%的初始活性，表明其具有优异的热稳定性。结构域截断分析揭示，Chondroitin AC/alginate lyase超家族结构域和Hepar_II_III催化结构域对于维持正确的蛋白质折叠、可溶性表达和催化活性至关重要。相比之下，C端T9SS分选结构域的缺失改善了异源表达系统中的酶性能，截短变体Algtm3dc的活性比野生型酶高1.98倍。结构建模和分子对接分析表明，C端截断保留了催化核心，同时诱导底物结合区域的局部变化，这可能有助于增强催化效率。TLC和ESI-MS分析表明，Algtm3能够降解海藻酸钠、polyM和polyG，主要产生聚合度范围为1至4的海藻酸寡糖，并表现出内切型和外切型降解特征。综合来看，这些发现为PL39家族海藻酸裂解酶的结构域组织和结构-功能关系提供了见解，并突显了Algtm3作为热稳定生物催化剂在高效生产功能性海藻酸寡糖方面的潜力。
